item.summary: Nobody in Gujarat had rehearsed for this, yet leadership rose to the moment. Local officers decided on the spot, even as networks failed. The Centre released Rs. 500 crore that same day. Within two weeks, a new authority, chaired by the Chief Minister, took charge of recovery. Villagers shaped decisions, and families led the rebuilding of their own homes. District Judges, serving as ombudsmen,…
item.title: Kutch Earthquake 2001
